# Components Implementation Guide

## Purpose

This directory contains reusable UI components following Astro patterns with TypeScript and CSS Modules.

## Directory Structure

```
components/
├── foundation/    # Base UI components
│   ├── Button/
│   ├── Card/
│   └── Callout/
└── layout/       # Layout-specific components
    ├── Header/
    └── Footer/
```

## Implementation Patterns

### Component Structure

All components follow this pattern:

```
ComponentName/
├── index.astro      # Main component with Props interface
└── styles.module.css # CSS Module styles
```

### Props Interface

```typescript
interface Props {
  href?: string;
  variant?: 'primary' | 'secondary' | 'gold';
  size?: 'small' | 'medium' | 'large';
  fullWidth?: boolean;
  type?: 'button' | 'submit' | 'reset';
  disabled?: boolean;
  class?: string;
}

const { href, variant = 'primary', ... } = Astro.props;
```

### Conditional Rendering

```astro
{href ? (
  <a href={href} class:list={classList}>
    <slot />
  </a>
) : (
  <button type={type} disabled={disabled} class:list={classList}>
    <slot />
  </button>
)}
```

### CSS Modules Usage

```typescript
import styles from './styles.module.css';

// Apply classes
const classList = [
  styles.button,
  styles[variant],
  styles[size],
  fullWidth && styles.fullWidth,
  className
].filter(Boolean);
```

```astro
<div class:list={classList}>
  <slot />
</div>
```

### Slot Usage

Named slots for flexible content:

```astro
<Card href={topic.href} variant="evidence" icon={topic.icon}>
  <span slot="title">{topic.title}</span>
  {topic.description}
</Card>
```

```astro
<!-- In Card/index.astro -->
<div class={styles.card}>
  <div class={styles.icon}>{icon}</div>
  <slot name="title" />
  <div class={styles.content}>
    <slot />
  </div>
</div>
```

## Common Tasks

### Adding New Component

1. Create folder with `index.astro` and `styles.module.css`
2. Define Props interface with TypeScript
3. Implement component with conditional rendering
4. Export styles via CSS Modules
5. Add to parent layout/page

### Modifying Existing Component

1. Update Props interface if adding new props
2. Maintain backward compatibility
3. Update CSS Modules for new styles
4. Test in multiple contexts
